parameters.help_en: The list of log codes. The value must be a JSON array
parameters.name: log_codes

parameters.help_en: The code of the multicloud environment
parameters.name: cloud_code

parameters.help_en:
The view type.

0: The view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.

1: The view of all accounts that belong to the enterprise
parameters.help_zh:
视图类型。

0：当前阿里云账号视图。
1：企业下所有账号的视图
parameters.name: role_type

parameters.help_en: The user ID of the member. This parameter allows an administrator to switch to the perspective of a member account
parameters.help_zh: 管理员切换成其他成员视角的用户ID
parameters.name: role_for

parameters.help_en:
The region where the Data Management center of Threat Analysis is located. Select the region based on the region where your assets are located. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: Your assets are in the Chinese mainland or China (Hong Kong).

ap-southeast-1: Your assets are outside China

威胁分析的数据管理中心所在地。您需要根据资产所在地域，选择管理中心所在地。取值：

ap-southeast-1：资产属于海外地域
